arguments.message:
To set up a custom domain for your support portal, you’ll need to add two DNS records at your domain host:

1. **CNAME** – point the subdomain you want to use (e.g., support.yourcompany.com) to Meridian’s portal address (the URL shown in Settings → General → Custom domain).
2. **TXT** – add the verification record Meridian provides to prove ownership of the domain before the custom domain is activated.

Once both records are in place, Meridian will automatically verify the domain; the status will show as pending or verified on the custom‑domain settings page. No other records are required.
